privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How plusconverter.ge collects, uses, and stores your data.
privacy.intro: This page explains what data plusconverter.ge collects when you use the service, and how it's used. We collect the minimum needed to process your orders.

dataCollected.title: What we collect
dataCollected.body: When you sign in with Google, we store your email and name. When you place an order, we store the bank or PLUS account details, username, and comment you provide, along with order amounts and status.

howUsed.title: How it's used
howUsed.body: Your data is used only to process your orders — to send you points or GEL, show your order history, and display your chosen username on public reviews.

storage.title: Storage & security
storage.body: Data is stored in Supabase (Postgres) with Row Level Security enabled, so you can only access your own records. We don't sell or share your data with third parties.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies only for authentication (keeping you signed in) and remembering your language preference — no tracking or advertising cookies.

contact.title: Questions or data requests
contact.body: To ask about your data or request deletion, contact us on Telegram: @plusconverter.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for buying and selling Bank of Georgia PLUS points on plusconverter.ge.
terms.intro: By using plusconverter.ge to buy or sell Bank of Georgia PLUS points, you agree to the terms below. This is an independent, informal service — please read carefully before placing an order.

rates.title: Rates
rates.body: The exchange rate is set by us and can change at any time. The rate shown when you start an order is locked in for that order.

finality.title: No refunds
finality.body: Once you have sent PLUS points or GEL for an order, the transaction is final. We cannot reverse a transfer once it has been sent, so double-check the order details before paying.

accountDetails.title: Your account details
accountDetails.body: You are responsible for entering your correct bank account or PLUS account details. We are not liable for points or funds lost because of incorrect details you provided.

orderExpiry.title: Order timer
orderExpiry.body: Each order must be paid within the countdown shown on the order page. Orders that expire, go unpaid, or appear fraudulent may be cancelled by us.

disclaimer.title: Not affiliated with Bank of Georgia
disclaimer.body: plusconverter.ge is an independent service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Bank of Georgia. "PLUS" refers to Bank of Georgia's loyalty points program, used here descriptively.

contact.title: Questions or disputes
contact.body: For any questions or issues with an order, contact us on Telegram: @plusconverter.
